title: Finally, watch this Fizzy orientation video
description: There’s a whole lot more you can do in Fizzy. In the video below, 37signals founder and CEO, Jason Fried, will walk you through the basics in just 17 minutes.
plain:
There’s a whole lot more you can do in Fizzy. In the video below, 37signals founder and CEO, Jason Fried, will walk you through the basics in just 17 minutes.

[Fizzy orientation]

title: Then, set up a Passkey
description: Passkeys let you sign in securely without using passwords or email codes. To set one up, open the Fizzy menu and go to “My Profile > Manage Passkeys”. Using a passkey is optional, but recommended.
plain:
Passkeys let you sign in securely without using passwords or email codes. To set one up, open the Fizzy menu and go to “My Profile > Manage Passkeys”. Using a passkey is optional, but recommended.

[Create a passkey to sign in without passwords or email codes]

title: Now, grab the invite link to invite someone else
description: Open the Fizzy menu, select “+ Add people”, then copy the invite link. You can give this link to someone else so they can make a login for themselves in your account.
plain:
Open the Fizzy menu, select “+ Add people”, then copy the invite link. You can give this link to someone else so they can make a login for themselves in your account.

[Get a link to invite co-workers]

title: Then, head back home to check out activity
description: Hit “1” or pull down the Fizzy menu and select “Home”.
plain:
Hit “1” or pull down the Fizzy menu and select “Home”.

[Go back to Home for Latest Activity]

title: Now, check out all cards assigned to you
description: Pull down the Fizzy menu at the top of the screen, and select “Assigned to me” or just hit “2” on your keyboard any time.
plain:
Pull down the Fizzy menu at the top of the screen, and select “Assigned to me” or just hit “2” on your keyboard any time.

[See all cards assigned to me]

title: Then, open the Fizzy menu
description: The Fizzy menu is how you get around the app. Click “Fizzy” at the top of the screen or hit the “J” key on your keyboard to pop it open.
plain:
The Fizzy menu is how you get around the app. Click “Fizzy” at the top of the screen or hit the “J” key on your keyboard to pop it open.

[Open the Fizzy menu]

title: Next, assign this card to yourself
description: Click the little head with the + next to it, then pick yourself.
plain:
Click the little head with the + next to it, then pick yourself.

[Assign this to yourself]

title: Now, tag this card “Design” then move it to YES
description: Click the little Tag icon, type “design”, then “Create tag”. Then, move the card to the new “YES” column you created in the previous step.
plain:
Click the little Tag icon, type “design”, then “Create tag”. Then, move the card to the new “YES” column you created in the previous step.

[Tag this #design]

title: Next, make two more columns
description:
1. Make one called "Yes"
  2. Make another called "Working on"

Go back to the Board view, click the little “+” to the right of the DONE column, name the column, pick a color, then do it again.


After that, drag this card to “DONE” or select “DONE” in the sidebar.
plain:
1. Make one called "Yes"

  2. Make another called "Working on"

Go back to the Board view, click the little “+” to the right of the DONE column, name the column, pick a color, then do it again.



After that, drag this card to “DONE” or select “DONE” in the sidebar.

[Make two more columns]

title: Second, move this card to NOT NOW
description: You can either select “NOT NOW” over in the sidebar, or you can go back out to the board view and drag this card into the “NOT NOW” column on the left side.
plain:
You can either select “NOT NOW” over in the sidebar, or you can go back out to the board view and drag this card into the “NOT NOW” column on the left side.



[Move to Not Now]

title: First, rename this card
description:
1. Click the title and you can rename the card, change the description, or add more information to the card.
  2. Then, hit "Mark as Done" at the bottom of the card.
  3. Finally, hit “Back to Playground” in the top left of the screen to go back to the board.
plain:
1. Click the title and you can rename the card, change the description, or add more information to the card.

  2. Then, hit "Mark as Done" at the bottom of the card.

  3. Finally, hit “Back to Playground” in the top left of the screen to go back to the board.

[Rename this card]
